reuse.why: Follows the existing assertNotLinkedElsewhere guard pattern in accounts/app.ts with a sibling assertNotClosed helper; it queries the account row separately rather than reusing the upgrade-path row lookup, which is a minor extra read.

duplication.why: The closed-account rule is written once in assertNotClosed; only a one-line call is repeated in each of the six provider link functions, consistent with how the tree already repeats per-provider guards.

placement.why: The guard sits in the server accounts layer next to the existing link precondition helper and runs before any bank creation, update or sync.

scope.why: Only the new helper and its six call sites; no unrelated edits.

maintainability.why: Small, readable guard applied uniformly to all providers; a new provider would still need to remember the call, as with the existing guard.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the same guard-helper approach as assertNotLinkedElsewhere; no existing abstraction bypassed.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the rule lives in one helper.

one_place.where: assertNotClosed in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by all six link*Account functions (goCardless, simpleFin, pluggyAi, akahu, fintegra, enableBanking).
